spec.description: Returns the last ~200 top-of-book spreads for a given pair.

pair.description: Asset pair to get data for.

assetVersion.description: Controls whether response keys use Kraken's internal names or display names. Omitted (default): internal names are used. `assetVersion=1`: display names are used. Only `assetVersion=1` is currently supported.

since.description: Returns spread data since given timestamp. Optional, intended for incremental updates within available dataset (does not contain all historical spreads).

asset_class.description: This parameter is required on requests for non-crypto pairs, i.e. use `tokenized_asset` for xstocks.

response.title: SpreadResult
response.description: Spreads keyed by pair, plus the polling cursor.

last.description: ID to be used as `since` when polling for new spread data.

additionalProperties.description: This pair's recent top-of-book spreads, oldest first.

notes: No pagination block: `since`/`last` is an incremental-update cursor over a live feed that 'does not contain all historical spreads' per the docs, not a bounded, walkable collection.
